SELECT * FROM category
AND category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{categoryName}, '%')
AND parent_id = #{parentId}
AND description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{description}, '%')

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.description, p.price, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.category_name, c.parent_id, c.sort_order, c.description AS category_description FROM category c LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON c.id = pc.category_id LEFT JOIN product p ON pc.product_id = p.id ORDER BY c.sort_order, p.id

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.description, p.price, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.category_name, c.parent_id, c.sort_order, c.description AS category_description FROM category c LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON c.id = pc.category_id LEFT JOIN product p ON pc.product_id = p.id WHERE c.id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY p.id
